newsitem.title: USA: U.S. 96/97 sugar stocks/use ratio 15.6 pct-USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. 96/97 sugar stocks/use ratio 15.6 pct-USDA.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department forecast Friday a 1996-97 sugar stocks-to-use ratio of 15.6 percent, a key figure in setting the import quota.

At the start of fiscal 1997, USDA allocated 1.7 million tonnes of imports with adjustments to be considered in January, March and May. If the stocks ratio is 15.5 percent or less on the review dates, the quota automatically goes up 200,000 tonnes. If it is higher, the tranche is cancelled.
